test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

They could not reach the railway station before the train _______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**left**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**left**" is the simple past tense form of the verb "**leave**."
 
• The sentence describes an action that occurred in the past, so the past tense "**left**" is required.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and **4 **are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"They could not reach the railway station before the train **left**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "leave"** is incorrect because it is in the present tense.
 
• **Option 3: "has been leaving"** is incorrect; it is in the present perfect continuous tense which does not fit this context.
 
• **Option 4: "has leave"** is incorrect because it is not a proper verb form.
